what: Hover over the card (a square photo like an album jacket) and it tilts in 3D following the mouse position, up to 25° at 1000px perspective, and lifts to 1.05x, with a white glare gradient over it up to .4 on the side opposite the mouse. Follow time .4s cubic-bezier(.03,.98,.52,.99). On release it returns upright — vanilla-tilt

options.reset: If false, stays tilted even after release

note: Load _vendor/vanilla-tilt@1.8.1/vanilla-tilt.min.js first. It is not applied on touch devices (hover false) or with reduced motion (the original also removes cardJs on mobile). The glare color is the white light built into the library.

from.where: index.html .sk-disco__photo (original #main .discographyUl .photo.cardJs — VanillaTilt.init max 25 · speed 400 · perspective 1000 · scale 1.05 · reset · glare · max-glare .4)
